input: Purchasing manager at a Santiago sushi caterer here; we're doing a client's year-end corporate event for 200 guests and need fresh, never-frozen, sashimi-grade Atlantic salmon, about 32 kg trimmed, pin-boned, skin-off fillet (D-trim or better). It should be as close to harvest as we can get and hold a firm texture on nigiri and sashimi. This client matters, so best quality for the price. One supplier and one order, farm origin on the delivery documents, refrigerated delivery to our Providencia kitchen by 07:00 Thursday, total under CLP 450,000 including delivery. Please place the order with the best option.

experiences.name: Despensa Nikkei Sushi Pantry Pack (200 guests)
experiences.description: Everything dry for a 200-guest sushi service in one order: 25 kg of Japanese short-grain sushi rice, rice vinegar, 400 full-size nori sheets, wasabi paste, pickled ginger and naturally brewed soy sauce in catering formats. Supplied by a Japanese-import distributor in Estación Central, Santiago; dry goods are delivered on pallets Wednesday afternoon.

experiences.name: Pesquera Reloncaví Harvest-Fresh Salmon Fillets
experiences.description: Chilled within minutes of harvest for maximum firmness on nigiri. Fresh, never frozen Atlantic salmon, sashimi grade: 32 kg of D-trim fillets, skinned and pin-boned. Harvest method: fish are not stunned; they go from the pen straight into an ice slurry, are held until motionless, then gill-cut and bled. Farm origin: Calbuco, Los Lagos Region, stated on the delivery note. Harvested Tuesday, filleted Wednesday, packed in sealed EPS boxes with gel ice and trucked overnight under refrigeration to Santiago. Refrigerated delivery across Santiago, including Providencia, before 07:00 Thursday; freight included.

experiences.name: Frigorífico Austral Sashimi-Grade Salmon Fillets
experiences.description: Sashimi-grade Atlantic salmon prepared for hotels and caterers, with an even texture for nigiri and sashimi. Fresh, never frozen: 32 kg of D-trim fillets, pin-boned and skinned, harvested Tuesday. Harvest method: each fish is stunned by an automated percussive stunner as it leaves the pen, then gill-cut and bled in chilled water. Farm origin: Aysén Region, recorded on every delivery note. Filleted Wednesday, packed in EPS boxes with gel ice and flown overnight from Balmaceda to Santiago, then by refrigerated van across the city, Providencia included, before 07:00 Thursday. Freight included.

experiences.name: Huerta Central Maki Prep Box for 200
experiences.description: Pre-cut vegetable fillings for 200 guests' worth of maki: ripe avocado, cucumber batons, blanched asparagus, mango, julienned carrot, pickled radish and chives, prepped for rolling straight out of the crate. Produce is sourced at Lo Valledor market, cut Wednesday night and delivered in chilled crates at 06:30 Thursday.

experiences.name: Castro Mar 36-Hour Sashimi Salmon
experiences.description: Harvest-to-kitchen in 36 hours, with dense, firm flesh ideal for sashimi; trusted by Santiago sushi bars. Fresh, never frozen Atlantic salmon, sashimi grade: 32 kg of D-trim fillets, pin-boned and skinned. Harvest method: fish are not stunned; they are placed in a CO₂-saturated seawater tank until motionless, then gill-cut and bled in chilled water. Farm origin: Chiloé Island, listed on each delivery document. Vacuum-packed in 4–5 kg units and flown Wednesday from El Tepual to Santiago, then by refrigerated van across Santiago, including Providencia, before 07:00 Thursday. Freight included.

experiences.name: Pacífico Sur Sushi-Grade Salmon Fillets
experiences.description: Sushi-grade Atlantic salmon line for restaurants and events, harvest date printed on each box. Fresh, never frozen, sashimi grade: 32 kg of D-trim fillets, skinned and pin-boned. Harvest method: fish are electrically stunned in water as they are pumped from the well-boat, then gill-cut and bled in chilled water. Farm origin: Puerto Aysén area, shown on all delivery documents. Vacuum-packed in 4–5 kg units, moved Wednesday by refrigerated truck and air cargo to our Quilicura depot, then delivered chilled across Santiago, including Providencia, before 07:00 Thursday. Freight included.

experiences.name: NovaMar Plant-Based Salmon-Style Sashimi
experiences.description: A salmon-style topping made from konjac and tomato, with the colour and marbled look of fresh fillet, for nigiri, rolls and sashimi platters. Supplied as 32 kg-equivalent in pre-sliced pieces and blocks. Produced at a food-tech plant in Santiago and shipped chilled in 1 kg trays with a 14-day refrigerated shelf life.
